title: Key paths as reusable property access
summary: Pass typed property references with KeyPath and WritableKeyPath to read and update models generically.
code: from roots: [Root], at path: KeyPath<Root, Value>
at path: WritableKeyPath<Root, Value>, to value: Value
triggers: pass a property accessor as a typed value to generic code
prompts: Extract contact names and update a chosen writable field through reusable functions.
invariant: The key path fixes the root type, property type and write capability at compile time.
mantra: Read with KeyPath; write with WritableKeyPath.
pitfalls: A read-only KeyPath cannot be used for assignment.
Updating a struct through inout requires & at the call site.
